description: Decision and spec routing, proportional evidence gathering, contextual critique, authorization inheritance, and schema validation.

evals.name: build-verb-promotes-to-spec-shape
evals.prompt: /forge add user authentication with OAuth and email/password
evals.expected_output: The `add` verb in the idea fires the Spec promotion rule. Output is a `# Spec:` artifact with a Decision header (chosen approach + rationale, runner-up + what would flip it, Surfaced forks for any load-bearing call, Escalated forks for user-owned ones), an Assumption ledger tagging each load-bearing assumption verified fact / assumption / inherited convention, then Overview, Goals, Non-goals, Background, one or more ### WS-N workstreams each with Priority (P0/P1/P2), Complexity (S/M/L/XL), Description, Tasks, Acceptance criteria, plus Execution order.

evals.name: three-tier-decide-surfaces-load-bearing-forks
evals.prompt: /forge -s build a notifications service for our app
evals.expected_output: Phase 3 runs three tiers. Forge DECIDES the reversible and conventional calls (naming, file layout, test strategy, library picks where one is clearly better) with a one-line rationale each. It SURFACES the structurally load-bearing forks in the Decision header's Surfaced forks line — for example the event-shape (push events vs polling), the storage choice if it constrains future features, the delivery-channel architecture — each named with the pick, the runner-up, and what would flip it. It ESCALATES only the few user-owned forks (which channels to launch with, any budget ceiling). The Surfaced forks line is not 'none' when load-bearing calls genuinely exist — that would be the overengineering tell.

evals.name: reframes-stated-problem-before-research
evals.prompt: /forge we need to add a caching layer to speed up the dashboard
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 (Hunt) reframes the stated solution ('add a caching layer') into the real problem and writes 1-3 'How might we' framings before any research. It does not accept the solution-in-disguise at face value, and names the framing it will pursue.

evals.name: diverges-before-evaluating
evals.prompt: /forge should we move our background jobs off Cloudflare Queues
evals.expected_output: Phase 2 (Judge) identifies viable approaches with distinct mechanisms and states which constraints each serves. Include keeping the current system when it remains viable. Compare the actual choices without inventing alternatives to satisfy a minimum count.

evals.name: stress-test-then-adversarial-panel-and-convergence
evals.prompt: /forge should we adopt a Turborepo monorepo for our 4 services
evals.expected_output: Stress-test against the original brief, constraints, and evidence. Select relevant independent critics for material risks; zero findings is valid. Resolve each finding with correction, counterevidence, or an explicit unresolved risk. An author score cannot clear a dispute.

evals.name: saves-to-canonical-path
evals.prompt: /forge -s redesign the billing system
evals.expected_output: With -s and the `redesign` verb triggering Spec promotion, the artifact is written to `~/.agents/output/{project}/forge/forge-{slug}.md` ({slug} = kebab of the idea; {project} = repo basename), and the fully-expanded absolute path is reported back with the `/apex -f <that path>` bridge command.

evals.name: acceptance-criteria-given-when-then
evals.prompt: /forge add CSV export to the reports page
evals.expected_output: Every workstream's acceptance criteria stay `- [ ]` checklist items phrased Given/When/Then, cover happy + error + edge, and include at least one negative criterion (what must NOT happen). No vague words (fast, intuitive, robust). The skill routes to references/spec-craft.md for the criteria discipline rather than re-deriving it inline.

evals.name: pre-save-audit-then-validate
evals.prompt: /forge -s add a real-time collaboration layer to the document editor
evals.expected_output: Before save, the skill walks the pre-save audit in references/spec-craft.md § Pre-save audit — checking AC vagueness, P0 ruthlessness, goals as outcomes vs outputs, non-goal rationale tags, no XL workstreams, dependency consistency, blocking-vs-non-blocking split, and surfaced-forks-not-empty when load-bearing calls exist. Rewrites anything flagged and re-walks the list. Then runs `python3 "$SKILL_DIR"/scripts/validate_spec.py <output_file>`, exit 0 required. Both gates pass; the audit catches what the schema validator cannot.

evals.name: exploratory-question-defaults-to-decision-and-pauses
evals.prompt: /forge should we use Neon or Supabase for our serverless Postgres
evals.expected_output: No build verb, no decomposition signal, no -a, no -i — the routing emits the default Decision shape. Output is H1 `# Decision:`, the chosen option with rationale, the runner-up with what would flip it, Surfaced forks for any load-bearing calls, Assumption ledger. No workstreams, no `/apex` bridge. After presenting the decision, the skill asks the user whether to decompose into workstreams and WAITS — restoring the discuss-then-build seam. It does not silently promote to Spec and ship workstreams the user did not ask for.

evals.name: revision-pause-after-spec-save
evals.prompt: /forge -s add search functionality to the docs site
evals.expected_output: Save and validate the spec. Pause only for a requested planning checkpoint or missing implementation authorization. Silence is never approval. Continue an existing build mandate without asking again.

evals.name: issues-mode-forces-spec-promotion-with-ledger-note
evals.prompt: /forge -a -i migrate from REST to GraphQL
evals.expected_output: With -i (which forces -s) AND -a, the routing promotes to Spec on multiple conditions (auto_mode AND issues_mode AND the `migrate` build verb). The skill reads references/issue-creation.md, verifies gh auth, creates labels idempotently, then creates a parent epic plus one child issue per workstream with priority/complexity/forge labels and parent-child cross-references, and appends a ## GitHub Issues mapping. If issues_mode had been the only promotion condition (e.g. `/forge -i should we use Neon or Supabase`), the Assumption ledger would carry a one-line note recording the forced promotion.

evals.name: auto-mode-decides-and-emits-without-pausing
evals.prompt: /forge -a -s build an internal documentation site for the engineering team
evals.expected_output: Under auto mode resolve reversible details within existing scope, record material assumptions, and finish the artifact. User-owned decisions or missing authorization remain pending while independent work continues.

evals.name: routes-to-thinking-tools-when-stuck
evals.prompt: /forge every database option I consider is just a variant of 'use Postgres' — help me break out
evals.expected_output: When divergence collapses to one mechanism, the skill routes to references/thinking-tools.md for an on-demand technique (first-principles, inversion, reverse-brainstorm, or elimination) rather than inlining the technique list. It reads the reference only when the option set is thin, not on every run.

evals.name: too-many-workstreams-suggests-split
evals.prompt: /forge rebuild the entire admin dashboard: auth, RBAC, billing, analytics, audit log, settings, notifications, and a public API
evals.expected_output: Decompose the accepted scope into natural, dependency-aware workstreams. Split an oversized workstream or plan when that improves independent execution and verification, preserving the full requested outcome. A count over seven does not itself require splitting or dropping work.

evals.name: non-markdown-from-file-aborts
evals.prompt: /forge -f requirements.pdf "plan the requirements"
evals.expected_output: A non-Markdown -f source (.pdf, .docx, audio, video, YouTube) is not read as binary. The skill stops and instructs the user to pre-process with `/markitdown -s <path>` and pass the saved Markdown path, rather than guessing at the contents.

evals.name: from-file-prior-spec-preserves-spec-shape
evals.prompt: /forge -s -f ~/.agents/output/example-project/forge/forge-oauth-auth.md tighten the OAuth plan
evals.expected_output: The `-f` argument points at a prior Spec artifact (H1 `# Spec:` and `## Workstreams`). The routing detects the prior Spec shape and preserves it — `tighten the plan` is not a build verb, but iterating on an existing Spec without preserving its workstreams would emit a near-empty Decision and lose the WS-N structure. The skill reads the path verbatim per repo-conventions.md § Pipeline chaining (no glob, no inference), carries forward the Assumption ledger, and emits the refined Spec with updated workstreams.

evals.name: adversarial-panel-catches-overengineering
evals.prompt: /forge -s build a job queue with priorities, dead-letter queues, exponential backoff, idempotency tokens, distributed tracing, and circuit breakers for our weekly cron
evals.expected_output: Use the simplicity lens to test whether the proposed infrastructure serves the actual scale and constraints. Ground findings in evidence; no minimum critic count or author score determines the result.

evals.name: economy-mode-skips-subagents-including-panel
evals.prompt: /forge -e -s add search functionality
evals.expected_output: Economy mode uses direct research and a separate self-check. Preserve necessary evidence and accepted outcomes; disclose that the check shares the author's context.

evals.name: research-floor-forces-min-two-agents
evals.prompt: /forge should we name the cache key by user id or by session id
evals.expected_output: Research the actual cache-key contract and unresolved failure modes. Delegate only concrete independent questions when that adds value. There is no minimum agent count or mandatory external pass for a question resolved by repository evidence.

evals.name: convergence-bounded-to-two-rounds
evals.prompt: /forge should we shard the events table by tenant now or defer it
evals.expected_output: Resolve material disputes through evidence. Request a targeted independent check only when it can resolve a specific remaining question; otherwise disclose uncertainty. No score or forced finding quota establishes truth.

evals.name: kill-criteria-emitted-with-tripwire-and-date
evals.prompt: /forge -s migrate our search from Postgres full-text to a dedicated engine
evals.expected_output: The artifact carries a Kill criteria section with 2-3 measurable tripwires, each a state plus a date or milestone ('if relevance quality has not beaten the Postgres baseline by the Q3 review, abandon and revisit'), pre-committed before sunk cost clouds the call. For a commitment with a real exit cost the section is populated, not 'none'. A pure tech choice with no abort commitment may record 'none'.

evals.name: research-findings-section-cited-and-tagged
evals.prompt: /forge should we use Drizzle or Prisma for our Neon Postgres
evals.expected_output: The Decision artifact carries a Research findings section that makes the evidence visible rather than burying it in the Assumption ledger: the load-bearing findings, each with its source and a quality tag (primary / secondary / blog / anecdote / vendor-marketing), and any divergence surfaced rather than smoothed over. The section is prominent in the Decision shape; in a promoted Spec shape it condenses to a 2-3 bullet digest.

evals.name: premortem-gap-triggers-auto-second-research-round
evals.prompt: /forge should we move session storage from cookies to Redis
evals.expected_output: When the premortem exposes a consequential unresearched failure mode, follow references/research-discipline.md to investigate that specific gap before deciding. Use a concrete independent research task when useful and available, or direct evidence otherwise. Incorporate the result or explicitly preserve the unresolved uncertainty.

evals.name: authorized-build-without-persistent-save
evals.prompt: GO implement the accepted redirect correction. Use /forge -S to prepare the small plan first, then finish the change; do not save a persistent plan artifact.
evals.expected_output: Write and validate a temporary Spec, then pass its absolute path to /apex -f for the authorized implementation. Keep the temporary file available until consumed. Do not stop at a rerun-with-s note or introduce a new implementation approval; respect an explicit later checkpoint if given.

evals.name: convergence-checks-source-against-author-claim
evals.prompt: The critic says the plan drops the required retry-idempotency guarantee. The author replies that the guarantee is unnecessary. Review that rebuttal against the original brief, which explicitly requires idempotent retries.
evals.expected_output: Use references/subagent-prompts.md to give the convergence skeptic the brief, constraints and relevant source artifacts alongside the finding and rebuttal. Inspect that evidence and confirm the omitted requirement; author confidence cannot remove an accepted criterion. Do not forward unrelated panel findings.

evals.name: binary-choice
evals.prompt: Use /forge to decide whether to retain the present cache or remove it. Product constraints rule out replacing it, and these are the only two viable options.
evals.expected_output: Compare the two viable options against the constraints and record the actual runner-up and tradeoff. Do not fabricate a third architecture to satisfy a numerical minimum.

evals.name: economy-evidence-gap
evals.prompt: Use /forge -e for this small configuration decision. One vendor behavior remains unverified and no independent agent tool is available.
evals.expected_output: Investigate the consequential gap directly using available authoritative evidence. Do not require extra agents or claim a critic was run. If the behavior cannot be verified, preserve the uncertainty and its decision consequence.

evals.name: respect-taste-owner
evals.prompt: Use /forge to plan the page. I have chosen the existing brand palette. A new illustration style is still undecided and I have not delegated that taste decision.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the already chosen palette without reopening approval. Advance independent planning, then present the material illustration choice to the user instead of silently choosing or declaring implementation complete.
